EXTENSION.JMCMODLIB.CONFIG.AllCardIs.ena: No restart is required after disabling this; the Harmony patch remains installed, but it reads this value and lets all cards pass through.
EXTENSION.JMCMODLIB.CONFIG.AllCardIs.tar: Enter WHITE_NOISE or CARD.WHITE_NOISE; built-in Chinese aliases such as 白噪音 and 死亡收割 are also supported. Changes take effect immediately.
EXTENSION.JMCMODLIB.CONFIG.AllCardIs.sou: When enabled, attack cards are replaced with the target card; when disabled, attack cards stay unchanged.
When enabled, power cards are replaced with the target card; when disabled, power cards stay unchanged.
When enabled, skill cards are replaced with the target card; when disabled, skill cards stay unchanged.
When enabled, curse cards are replaced with the target card; when disabled, curse cards stay unchanged.
When enabled, quest cards are replaced with the target card; when disabled, quest cards stay unchanged. Status cards are not replaced by this mod.
